Class ThresholdService

java.lang.Object
at.qe.skeleton.services.ThresholdService
@Service public class ThresholdService extends Object
Service responsible for managing Threshold entities and their lifecycle.

This service handles creation, updates, deletion, and evaluation-related side effects such as threshold violation management and Raspberry Pi synchronization.

Main responsibilities:

  • CRUD operations for thresholds
  • Validation of duplicate thresholds per room/metric/type
  • Management of climate hint associations
  • Handling active threshold violations
  • Synchronization with Raspberry Pi devices

    • update

      public Threshold update(Long id, ThresholdUpdateDTO dto)
      Updates an existing threshold and triggers Raspberry Pi synchronization.

      Also handles:

      • Validation against duplicate thresholds
      • Updating climate hints
      • Disabling violations if threshold is disabled
      • Synchronizing changes with Raspberry Pi
      Parameters:
      id - threshold ID
      dto - update data
      Returns:
      updated threshold entity

    • delete

      public void delete(Long id)
      Deletes a threshold and performs cleanup of all related associations.

      Before deletion:

      • Detaches climate hints
      • Detaches threshold violations
      • Notifies Raspberry Pi (even if already removed)
      Parameters:
      id - threshold ID
